as_told.title: Greer's CE-5 protocols and the interest of Stubblebine and Alexander

plain: A UFO researcher named Steven Greer is said to believe that ordinary people can call UFOs in on purpose, using a set of steps Michels calls the C5 protocols. Michels tells this himself on two episodes: in one he calls Greer a mixed bag but says his investigative work is now being vindicated, and in the other, speaking to a guest who had worked with Greer, he places the practice in the 1990s and adds that two men named Albert Stubblebine and John B. Alexander took an interest in it. If it worked, contact would not be something only governments could control.
